bug_semantics: ksmbd's smb_inherit_dacl() (fs/smb/server/smbacl.c) builds the child directory's inherited DACL by walking the parent directory's DACL loaded from the security descriptor xattr (security.NTACL, remotely settable via SMB2_SET_INFO by a client with directory-create permission). The walk validates only that each parent ACE contains the fixed SID header (offsetof(struct smb_ace, sid) + CIFS_SID_BASE_SIZE) but never checks that the variable-length SID advertised by parent_aces->sid.num_subauth is actually contained in the ACE. A crafted inheritable ACE can therefore advertise an inflated num_subauth (up to 255) while carrying almost no subauthority data: compare_sids() then reads past the end of the parent ACE buffer (heap OOB read), and smb_set_ace() — which clamps the copied destination SID via smb_copy_sid() but computes ace->size from the UNCHECKED source sid->num_subauth — advances the temporary inherited-ACE buffer pointer and the nt_size accumulator by an attacker-inflated stride, pushing subsequent writes and the final security-descriptor assembly (powner/pgroup SID sizes and pntsd allocation accounting, each computed as 1+1+6+num_subauth*4 from unchecked counts) past the allocated buffer: heap out-of-bounds read plus subsequent heap corruption (CWE-125), remotely triggerable, with kernel DoS and potential escalation to kernel code execution.
flaw_origin: Commit e2f34481b24db2fd634b5edb0a5bd0e4d38cc6e9 ('cifsd: add server-side procedures for SMB3', 2021-03-16, author Namjae Jeon <namjae.jeon@samsung.com>, committer Steve French <stfrench@microsoft.com>; parent 0626e6641f6b467447c81dd7678a69c66f7746cf) first wrote the entire vulnerable inheritance path in one commit: it created fs/cifsd/smbacl.c containing smb_set_ace() with the unchecked sink 'ace->size = cpu_to_le16(1 + 1 + 2 + 4 + 1 + 1 + 6 + (sid->num_subauth * 4))' (:950) and smb_inherit_dacl() (:953) which walks parent_aces->sid with no num_subauth bound and feeds it to compare_sids() and smb_set_ace(), and computes owner/group SID sizes as 1+1+6+num_subauth*4 from the parent xattr counts. The advisory's named sink (inherited-ACE SID length never validated against the ACE extent) is born here; every later ksmbd hardening commit in this area patched adjacent defects but left the per-ACE inherited-SID num_subauth check absent until the 2026 fix.

evidence: Advisory (CVE-2026-8449 / GHSA-898m-7rf9-qg74): Linux ksmbd remote memory corruption in the ACL inheritance path — crafted DACL with malformed SID carrying inflated num_subauth, set via SMB2_SET_INFO on a directory, triggers heap OOB read and heap corruption when child entries are created; CWE-125.

BIC first-write verification: `git show e2f34481b24d:fs/cifsd/smbacl.c` — :950 `ace->size = cpu_to_le16(1 + 1 + 2 + 4 + 1 + 1 + 6 + (sid->num_subauth * 4))` (size from UNCHECKED source SID count), :953 `int smb_inherit_dacl(...)` whose loop uses parent_aces->sid in compare_sids()/smb_set_ace() with no num_subauth-vs-ACE-extent validation, :1045/:1050 owner/group SID sizes from unchecked parent xattr num_subauth. Parent check: `git show 0626e6641f6b:fs/cifsd/smbacl.c` → 'fatal: path ... does not exist' — the file (and sink) did not exist before the BIC; e2f34481b24d is the first commit ever touching fs/cifsd/smbacl.c (git log --follow tail confirms it is the oldest).

Wave/hardening history between BIC and fix — none closed the named sink: eebff19acaa3 (2023-11-05, Namjae Jeon) validated only pntsd osid/gsid/dacloffset offsets; beff0bc9d69b (2025-03-29, Norbert Szetei) fixed dacloffset overflow; 3e4e2ea2a781 (2026-04-17, Michael Bommarito) validated num_aces vs pdacl_size and hardened the ACE walk minimum size — carries 'Assisted-by: Claude:claude-opus-4-6' (evidence-only, NOT the BIC); 69f030cf9548 (2026-05-19, Junyi Liu) added smb_validate_ntsd_sid() for owner/group SIDs only. At the fix's parent (6fd7dd4e44d7840cb1ba0c3a895e9f576af3fe5c) `git show ...:fs/smb/server/smbacl.c` still shows :1071 `ace->size = cpu_to_le16(... + (sid->num_subauth * 4))` from the unchecked source SID and zero occurrences of smb_append_inherited_ace (grep -c = 0).

Fix verification: 996454bc0da84d5a1dedb1a7861823087e01a7ae ('ksmbd: validate inherited ACE SID length', 2026-04-28, Shota Zaizen <s@zaizen.me>, merged by Steve French; parent 6fd7dd4e44d7840cb1ba0c3a895e9f576af3fe5c) — declared 'Fixes: e2f34481b24d ("cifsd: add server-side procedures for SMB3")'; adds the per-ACE check `parent_aces->sid.num_subauth > SID_MAX_SUB_AUTHORITIES || pace_size < offsetof(struct smb_ace, sid) + CIFS_SID_BASE_SIZE + sizeof(__le32) * parent_aces->sid.num_subauth` → break, plus smb_append_inherited_ace() computing ace size from the clamped ace->sid.num_subauth with check_add_overflow guards on nt_size and pntsd_alloc_size. Verified present at the fix commit (fs/smb/server/smbacl.c :1075/:1214/:1226) and absent at its parent (grep -c = 0).

Tag/ancestry: BIC e2f34481b24d first contained in v5.15-rc1 (ksmbd/cifsd shipped in 5.15, matching the advisory's affected range since 5.15); fix 996454bc0da8 first contained in v7.1-rc3 (git tag --contains; git merge-base --is-ancestor 996454bc0da8 v7.1 → yes). No stable backport branch exists in this clone (only origin/master; `git log --all --format='%H %s' | grep 'validate inherited ACE SID'` returns exactly the one mainline sha), and the fix carries 'Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org' — distro/stable backport shas are outside this clone's history.
